entries.clue: Slatted stand opened out by the radiator when the weather is against you
Little one of the Wood who fell in the river and thought it swimming
Grey donkey of the Wood who mislays his tail and expects the worst
Magical, as the high place where a boy and his bear are left at the last
Standing wires and running ropes of a boat, taken all together
Wire pad for shifting burnt-on food from a saucepan
Triangular sail set forward of the mast, sheeted in hard when beating upwind
Narrow line of hard filler round each tile, and it goes black with mould
Striped stranger who wakes the bear at night to announce who he is
Black plastic sack you drop in before the peelings go
Take a tuck in a sail and lash it down when the wind pipes up
Blade hung below the waterline; push the tiller across and the boat's head comes round
